claims: Tommy Lloyd is the head coach of the University of Arizona men’s basketball team as of March 2026.
As of March 2026 Tommy Lloyd is in his fifth season as head coach of the University of Arizona men’s basketball team.
Tommy Lloyd signed a five-year contract extension in 2025.
Arizona Men's Basketball is in the Big 12 Conference.
Tommy Lloyd led the Wildcats to an Elite Eight appearance in his fifth season.
Tommy Lloyd has the most wins of any head coach in NCAA Division I history over his first two seasons.
Tommy Lloyd has the most wins of any head coach in NCAA Division I history over his first five seasons.
Tommy Lloyd previously served as a longtime assistant coach at Gonzaga under Mark Few.
Tommy Lloyd's salary in his 2025 contract extension is set to exceed $5 million.
Tommy Lloyd's 2025 contract extension includes retention bonuses.
